propositions: Review gates currently read effective criteria from multiple sources, allowing project disables to be ignored and project DET criteria to disappear between reads
A single immutable CriteriaSnapshot must compile effective built-in criteria, project LLM criteria, project DET criteria, and routing metadata before any selection or model call
Project code-review LLM criteria must validate applies_to as a non-empty list of repository-relative globs, with ["**"] meaning unconditional selection including empty changed-files
The new non-empty-glob validation rule applies only to code-review project criteria at snapshot compile time, leaving shared _validate_applies_to intact for plan-review and other gates
Migration of project.review-phase-boundaries from applies_to: [] to applies_to: ["**"] preserves behavior while making the unconditional selection explicit under the new rule
